title: Website widget
subtitle: A chat window for your own website: visitors write to you, the message lands in the inbox, and your reply appears right in the visitor's widget. Every message can also go to Zapier, Make or your own system via webhook.

status.heading: Status
status.disabled: The widget is not active yet.
status.conversations: {count, plural, =0 {No website conversations yet} one {# website conversation in the inbox} other {# website conversations in the inbox}}

setup.heading: Setup
setup.text: Add these values to the app's .env and restart the app. The widget ID is public (it is part of the embed code); protection comes from the list of allowed websites and per-visitor limits.

embed.heading: Embed code
embed.text: Add this line to your website before </body> — e.g. in WordPress via a code snippet plugin or in Wix/Squarespace as “custom code”.

webhook.heading: Webhook
webhook.text: For every new visitor message and every sent reply, the app sends a POST to WEBSITE_WIDGET_WEBHOOK_URL:
webhook.hint: Verify the signature with your secret and reject old timestamps. Typical use: on widget.reply.sent, email conversation.email so the visitor gets the reply even after leaving the page.
